evidence.title: Minneapolis data center development pause approved by city council
evidence.supports: Confirms the Minneapolis City Council gave final approval to a six-month data center moratorium ordinance on June 25, 2026 (after an initial 8-5 vote on May 22 and a June 16 public hearing), covering data centers over 350,000 sq ft with a downtown exemption, running through approximately November 21, 2026.
evidence.quote: No data center facility shall be established, re-established, or expanded ... The moratorium runs through Nov. 21, 2026.

decisions.notes: This is a significant status change: the record was 'pending'/not enacted as of 2026-04-29, but the ordinance has since been fully adopted and, as of this research date (2026-07-31), remains in its active six-month window.
